findings.description: The new explicit self-speaker rule does not resolve the observed actor reversal in either completed trial. Literal excerpt validation plus inference labeling does not validate the actor of the paraphrase.
findings.recommendation: Bind findings to source speaker identity and expose that source label during generation/review. Add a regression where an explicit 我 acknowledgement cannot be attributed to the contact; re-evaluate actual saved findings, not just SDK/tool success.

findings.description: Trial 3 imports public-source seniority and start date into a finding whose only citation is m2. The quoted message supports product design at LatticeWorks, not seniority or April 2025. The output remains inference, so this is not an observed confirmed-state overwrite.
findings.recommendation: Keep chat findings limited to their cited messages; keep public claims in the existing source-linked profile fields, or introduce an explicitly separate multi-source finding contract. Add a regression for public detail attached to a chat-only excerpt.
